name: Better Badge – Customizable Product Badges (Advanced Product Labels) for WooCommerce
author: InnoCodia

sections.description:
Help your online shoppers notice your desired products more with eye-catchy, attention-grabbing product badges like ‘Best Seller,’ ‘On Sale,’ ‘Limited Stock,’ ‘New Arrival,’ ‘Free Shipping,’ and 100+ pre-made ready-to-use product labels.

Fully customizable, you can easily modify everything from shape, size, and colors to text, ensuring a perfect match with your brand.

Let’s say you’re running a sales campaign on Facebook, Instagram, GDN, or any of your favorite platforms. A customer sees your ad with a bold “Flat 40% OFF” deal and excitedly clicks on it. But after landing on a page with 100+ products, they struggle to find the one they saw in their feed. Frustrated, they leave without buying.

You not only lose the ad spend but also a potential customer!

That’s where product badges and labels become the ultimate savior!

That’s why 55% of marketers say product badges help reduce promotional costs while increasing CTR and conversions.

Better Badge – Fully Customizable Advanced Product Badges & Labels For WooCommerce Store

Better Badge is the most advanced and fully customizable WooCommerce plugin that helps to grab customer attention and increase conversions with eye-catching product labels. But if you think Better Badge is just another typical badge plugin, you’re so wrong!

With Better Badge, you can fully customize product labels, highlight special offers, and even replace WooCommerce’s default “On Sale” badges with unique designs, flexible shapes, and precise placement options. With just a few clicks, you can create Sale, New Arrival, Low Stock, Free Shipping, and even custom badges for any products you want.

Top Features of Better Badge – The Most Advanced Product Labels WooCommerce Plugin

At first, let’s take a quick look at all the promising features of the Better Badge:

  • Pre-made 100+ badge collection
  • Customize badge design
  • Unlimited badge creation
  • Add advanced product labels
  • Schedule product badge & label
  • Show on product pages
  • Easy-to-use interface
  • Multiple badge types
  • Different badge shapes
  • Upload custom image badges (PRO)
  • Dynamic discount badges (PRO)
  • Multi-currency support (PRO)
  • HTML badges (PRO)
  • Advance filter (PRO)

Let’s explain all of the top features of this Better Badge – Customizable WooCommerce Product Badges Plugin

🎨 Design the Perfect Product Badge

The Better Badge WooCommerce plugin lets you design the most customizable and eye-catching eCommerce product badges for your products by using editable text, colors, and whatnot!

To be more specific, you can customize the badges with editable text, text color, background color, border color, and more! Besides customizing the badge’s design, you can set the appearance style too. For example, you can set a custom badge shape, choose badge position from 9 pre-defined positions, add margin & padding, set border radius, height, width, etc.

Overall, you can say that this plugin is equipped with every feature to design a customized product badge for your eCommerce website. So, fine-tune your ecommerce product badges now and match your store’s branding and aesthetic with endless design possibilities!

🖼️ Ready-to-Use Badge Templates

Even though this WooCommerce product badge plugin has every feature you’ll need for badge creation, you don’t need to do it manually from scratch. Besides adding the functionality to create badges, we’ve included some ready-to-use WooCommerce product badges to speed up your badge creation process.

Our pre-made badge collection includes badges for sale, Halloween discounts, and other seasonal discounts. Simply choose a design from our library of professionally designed image badges and keep your online store up and running in no time.

🌠 Upload Custom Badge Images

If you don’t want to create a custom badge from scratch, you can also upload the badge image directly. This is possible because of the image uploading functionality of this Custom Product Badge for WooCommerce plugin. However, you have nothing to worry about regarding the image dimension. You can customize the badge’s dimensions even after uploading the image.

🔖 Wide Range of Badge Support

The Better Badge plugin supports a wide range of badge types to highlight your eCommerce products. Here are some of the supported badges:

  • New Product: Showcase recently added items by using a new product badge to attract customers.
  • Sale: Highlight discounted products to boost product sales.
  • Custom-Designed Badge: Create unique badges tailored to your brand.
  • Discount Sales: Display special offers and promotions within the product image.
  • New Arrivals: Feature the latest products in your store.
  • Seasonal Sales: Promote seasonal or holiday-specific deals.
  • Best Sellers: Highlight your top-performing products.
  • Exclusive Offer: Create a sense of exclusivity with limited-time offers.
  • Featured Product: Make special products stand out using a special badge.
  • Hot Item: Draw attention to trending or high-demand products.
  • Trending Now: Highlight products that are currently popular.
  • Price Drop: Notify customers about recent price reductions.
  • Flash Sale: Create urgency with time-limited sales.
  • Limited Edition: Emphasize the rarity of special products.

🧑‍💻 Customize Badges with HTML & CSS

This feature allows you to create truly unique and dynamic badges tailored to your needs. You can use the placeholders like {{discount_percentage}}, {{discount_value}}, {{regular_price}}, {{sale_price}}, {{category_name}}, {{tag_name}} and {{brand_name}} to automatically display discount price details on your badges.

Besides, you can also inject custom HTML and CSS to design badges that perfectly match your target customer psychology. With this level of granular customization, you will not only make visually stunning product badges but also boost your conversion rate.

📊 Auto-Update Badge Data

This Custom Product Badge for WooCommerce plugin automatically updates badge information based on real-time product data if you use the pre-defined placeholders. The available placeholders are:

  • {{discount_percentage}}
  • {{discount_value}}
  • {{regular_price}}
  • {{sale_price}}
  • {{category_name}}
  • {{tag_name}} and
  • {{brand_name}}

We’re continuously working on adding new placeholders to ease your product management even more!

So, whether it’s a price drop or a time-sensitive sale, your badges will be adjusted accordingly. There’s no need to update the products manually. This ensures your customers always see the most accurate and up-to-date product highlights.

This feature ensures that your customers always see the most relevant information whenever they visit your website. It’ll not only enhance their shopping experience but also boost trust in your store. Besides, it’s highly beneficial for store owners like you. It saves your time, reduces errors, and lets you focus on growing your business while the plugin handles the rest!

⏰ Badge Scheduling

Keeping track of product sales for upcoming campaigns is a tough nut to crack for every eCommerce store owner. However, it won’t be an issue if you utilize the advanced badge management system of the Better Badge plugin.

You can schedule badges by setting their visibility for your products. The badge scheduling option applies to both the entire website and individual products.

🔗 Add Multiple Badges to One Product

Most of the traditional WooCommerce product badge plugin lets the users add a single badge to the product. But why limit yourself to just one badge per product?

With this customizable product badges (advanced product labels) for WooCommerce plugin, you can assign multiple badges to a single product. Thus, you can highlight multiple attributes of a product simultaneously.

Let’s clarify it with a real-life example. Suppose you are offering a limited-time sale on your best-selling product. So, now you don’t need to worry about whether to add the badge for sale or best-selling product. The same thing goes for the limited stock of new products too. You can add both “New Arrival” and “Limited Stock” badges together to create urgency and excitement.

This flexibility lets you showcase the full picture of what makes each product special. It makes your products truly stand out and tell their full story!

🎭 Multiple Locations to Place the Badge

When adding multiple badges to the same product, the first question is: Where should you place those badges?

With this Custom Product Badge for WooCommerce plugin, you don’t have to worry about cluttered or overlapping badges. Our plugin offers flexible badge placement options to display each badge exactly where you want it. You have 9 different places to display those badges. These are:

  • Top Left
  • Top Center
  • Top Right
  • Center Left
  • Center
  • Center Right
  • Bottom Left
  • Bottom Center
  • Bottom Right

This ensures your badges are not only visually appealing but also strategically placed to serve as clear visual indicators of your current product promotion.

🖥️ Intuitive Badge Management System

Managing a website with lots of badges can be a real headache. But with the right badge management system, it becomes effortless. The Better Badge plugin offers an ideal badge management system to keep all your badges in one place.

So, no more jumping between multiple pages to manage your badges. Every badge is stored and accessible from a centralized and easy-to-use dashboard. Now, you can manage your badges seamlessly and focus on your business.

🔎 Highlight the Featured Products

Every special product has its own unique selling proposition, aka USP. You must promote those special products as much as possible to increase sales. Offering a coupon or discount code, displaying promotional advertisements, and other tactics are some fruitful strategies to increase the conversation rate and overall sales. To do so, you should first research the conversion triggers to determine which one is most effective for your product. Your analysis must include the customer psychology, their buying pattern, etc. However, if you are unable to showcase the product in front of your prospective clients, it will not be successful.

The Better Badge plugin can be used to design that customer badge for your featured product. It enables you to draw attention to a particular product by adorning it with a personalized badge. In addition to adding general badges to every item in your online store, you can also add them to particular items.

📱 Optimized for All Devices

Website responsiveness is a must-have feature for current websites. It ensures the perfect visibility of your website. However, product badges are often overlooked while working on website responsiveness. But remember, you are selling the products here, not the website. That’s why ensuring all product-related information is displayed properly across all devices is highly important.

However, if you don’t want the hassle of manually ensuring the responsiveness, this Custom Product Badge for WooCommerce plugin is here to help. It automatically makes your WooCommerce product badges responsive. No matter which device your customers use, they’ll get to view your website just fine.

🎭 Match Products with Your Brand’s Aesthetic

Your store’s design is a reflection of your brand. So, you must maintain consistency in color, design, and other brand styling guidelines throughout your whole website. The same rule applies for the product badges too! If your new product badges don’t match your brand’s aesthetics, it’ll look so inappropriate.

To help with it, this customizable product badges (advanced product labels) for WooCommerce plugin allows you to design fully customized badges for your eCommerce site. You can choose from a wide range of colors, fonts, shapes, and styles to create badges that seamlessly blend with your store’s aesthetic. So, no more hustling down for a perfect badge. Simply design your own badge with the Custom Product Badge for WooCommerce plugin.

Why Should You Use Better Badge – Fully Customizable WooCommerce Product Badges Plugin?

The Better Badge plugin helps you highlight key products and product labels for WooCommerce products, attract customer attention, and boost sales with eye-catching badges. Let’s find out the key reasons why this plugin is the best choice among others.

🔄 Works Seamlessly with WooCommerce

The Better Badge WooCommerce plugin works seamlessly with all WooCommerce products and themes. Even if you are using a custom-built WooCommerce theme, you can trust this plugin to work smoothly without any conflicts.

🚀 Fast & Lightweight

Speed matters a lot in eCommerce websites. Research shows that 40% of online shoppers left a website if it didn’t load within 3 seconds. So, if you want to load your website faster, there’s no alternative to using a faster website. And the Custom Product Badge for WooCommerce plugin is built to create your ecommerce product badges without hampering the website speed even a little bit!

✨ Highlight the Featured Products

Always make sure your new products don’t go unnoticed! Whether you’re launching a new product or offering a sale on your best-selling product, try adding a custom product badge to that. It will not only highlight the product itself but also attract the customers and boost your revenue.

⚠️ Create Urgency with the Limited Stock Alert

Scarcity sells! If you put a limited stock badge, it will work as a visual indicator for the customers about the rarity of that particular product. It will likely trigger the impulse buying mode of the shoppers and encourage them to act fast. At the end of the day, shoppers will be happy to get a rare product, and you’ll generate more revenue without any additional cost.

🎊 Special Badges for Seasonal Promotions

Everyone loves to get gift hampers or at least free shipping while shopping online during holidays. If you are also offering that, add a Free Shipping badge on your products and inform the shoppers. Besides, the holiday sales are highly time-sensitive promotions. So, it’s important to make the sale date and time right. But you don’t need to worry about that if you choose the Better Badge for WooCommerce plugin. You can add WooCommerce product badges and schedule it right from the plugin.

💸 Boost Revenue with Discount Badges

Discount badges are used not only to display product sale information, but they boost your revenue too. So, if you want to increase your revenue, it’s high time to add product badges to your WooCommerce products. And the best product badge plugin? Yeah, obviously, Better Badge!

How To Add a Badge To WooCommerce Products?

The Better Badge offers the most straightforward process to add a badge to your WooCommerce products. Here’s the step-by-step process of adding a product badge:

  • Navigate to WordPress Dashboard > Badge Manager.
  • Click on the New Badge button.
  • Add badge title, validity, text, color, etc.
  • Publish the badge by clicking on the Save Badge button.

That’s it! Easy-peasy!

Your custom badge will now become visible on the selected products in your WooCommerce store. However, if you don’t want the badge to go live immediately, you can also disable it manually.

Customer Support

If you have questions about the Better Badge plugin, we’re here to help you with any issue. There are two ways to get support from our professional support team:

  1. WordPress Support Forum: Visit the plugin’s support forum on WordPress to find solutions, ask questions, and get help from the community.
  2. Email Support: Need direct assistance? Email us at innocodia[@]gmail.com, and we’ll be happy to assist you.

No matter the issue, don’t hesitate to reach out to us. We’ll be there for you to help with any questions or concerns you may have!

Compatibility

This plugin is compatible with the latest versions of WordPress and WooCommerce.
sections.installation:
Before installing ** Better Badge – Customizable Product Badges (Advanced Product Labels) for WooCommerce plugin,** ensure your website meets these requirements:

  • PHP Version: 5.4 or greater
  • WordPress Version: 3.6 or greater
  • WooCommerce Version: 2.4 or greater

=Using The WordPress Dashboard=

  1. Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  2. Search for ‘Better Badge by Innocodia’
  3. Click ‘Install Now’
  4. Activate the plugin on the Plugin dashboard

=Uploading in WordPress Dashboard=

  1. Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  2. Navigate to the ‘Upload’ area
  3. Select custom-product-badge-for-woocommerce.zip from your computer
  4. Click ‘Install Now’
  5. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

=Using FTP=

  1. Download custom-product-badge-for-woocommerce.zip
  2. Extract the custom-product-badge-for-woocommerce directory to your computer
  3. Upload the custom-product-badge-for-woocommerce directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  4. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard
sections.faq:
What is Better Badge?

Better Badge is a fully customizable WooCommerce product badge plugin that allows ecommerce businesses to create eye-catching product badges and labels. With Better Badge, you can create or add unique product labels or badges on product images such as Sale, New Arrival, Low Stock, Free Shipping, and much more. These badges grab attention, create urgency, and increase conversions.

Why is Better Badge Important for WooCommerce Stores?

Better Badge enhances the user experience by highlighting product labels such as “On Sale,” “Limited Time Offer,” and more on product images. It ensures your best deals, offers, and promotions never go unnoticed, ultimately helping to increase conversions.

What types of badges can I create with Better Badge?

You can add different types of badges, such as a new product badge, free shipping badge, sale badge, discount badge, and whatever you can think of!

Can I add multiple badges to a single product?

Yes, you can assign multiple badges to a single product and choose different placement locations for each badge.

Is it possible to schedule badges for an upcoming seasonal sale?

Indeed, it is possible to schedule badges. The scheduled badges will be automatically activated at your preferred time and also automatically removed after the date expires.

Can I customize badge placement on product images?

Yes! You can select from nine distinct positions to guarantee that your product photos are seen as best they can be.

Can I create custom product badge designs?

Yes! You can fully customize badge designs by adjusting dimensions, colors, border styles, fonts, and positions to match your store’s branding. You can also upload custom images, icons, or use HTML for unique and high-impact designs.

Can I schedule badges to appear and disappear automatically?

Yes! Our plugin includes a Badge Scheduling feature that allows you to set specific start and end dates for badges. This is perfect for flash sales, holiday promotions, and time-sensitive discounts.

Can I apply badges to specific products, categories, or tags?

Yes! You can assign badges to individual products, entire categories, or specific tags in just a few clicks.

Can I use images or icons instead of text badges?

Yes! You can upload custom images, icons, or even use custom HTML to create unique and eye-catching product labels.

Does this plugin support multilingual or multi-currency stores?

Yes! It is compatible with popular translation and multi-currency plugins like WPML and Polylang, making it ideal for international stores.

Does Better Badge plugin work with any theme?

Yes, Better Badge is made to seamlessly work with any theme that is compatible with WooCommerce including Astra, Neve, OceanWP, Storefront, Flatsome, WoodMart, Divi, Flatsome, GeneratePress, Shopkeeper and more.

Is the plugin compatible with Elementor/Divi?

Yes! Better Badge is fully compatible with popular page builders like Elementor and Divi, allowing easy customization of product badges.

Does this work with WooCommerce multi-vendor stores?

Yes! Our plugin is compatible with popular WooCommerce multi-vendor plugins, allowing marketplace owners and individual vendors to apply badges to their products seamlessly.

Will Better Badge plugin slow down my WooCommerce site?

No, the plugin is ideal for WooCommerce stores and is very lightweight. So your eCommerce website won’t be slowed down.

How To Add a Badge To WooCommerce Products?

The Better Badge offers the most straightforward process to add a badge to your WooCommerce products. Here’s the step-by-step process of adding a product badge:

  • Navigate to WordPress Dashboard > Badge Manager.
  • Click on the New Badge button.
  • Add badge title, validity, text, color, etc.
  • Publish the badge by clicking on the Save Badge button.

That’s it! Easy-peasy!

Your custom badge will now become visible on the selected products in your WooCommerce store. However, if you don’t want the badge to go live immediately, you can also disable it manually.
